# sim-lib-numbers-stats

The statistics owner includes a public `SeededSampler` (`SplitMix64V1`) with
canonical replay receipts, exact word accounting, and labeled independent
substreams. `LatinHypercubePlan` and bounded `SobolPlan` generate reconstructable
unit-cube designs; `SweepPlan` adds exact boundary and exclusion evidence.
Descriptive inference includes explicit standardized-moment conventions and
one-/two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov method identity.
